# Data Model & Schema Specifications: Embeddable Customer Chat Widget Script

**Feature**: Embeddable Customer Chat Widget Script (`public/widget.js`)  
**Branch**: `008-embeddable-widget-script`  
**Date**: 2026-09-05  

---

## 1. Client-Side Data Models (Browser & LocalStorage)

### 1.1 LocalStorage Session Schema

The widget persists the visitor's conversation state in browser `localStorage` using the key:
`resolvdesk_session_${widgetKey}`

```typescript
interface StoredWidgetSession {
  /** Unique conversation UUID generated by the backend */
  conversation_id: string;

  /** Unix epoch timestamp (milliseconds) of the last message or interaction */
  last_active: number;

  /** Chronological history of turns stored locally for instant restoration */
  messages: StoredChatMessage[];

  /** Whether an escalation ticket has already been submitted for this session */
  is_escalated: boolean;

  /** Ticket reference number if escalated (e.g. "TK-7A3B91") */
  ticket_id?: string;
}

interface StoredChatMessage {
  id: string;
  role: "visitor" | "assistant" | "system";
  content: string;
  created_at: string;
  citations?: CitationItem[];
  suggest_escalation?: boolean;
}

interface CitationItem {
  document_id: string;
  title: string;
  source?: string;
}
```

**Lifecycle & Validation Rules**:
- **Sliding Expiration**: When initializing, if `Date.now() - session.last_active > 86,400,000` (24 hours), the session is considered expired and purged from `localStorage`.
- **Session Rehydration**: If a valid unexpired session exists, the widget renders existing messages into the conversation view and passes `conversation_id` on subsequent questions.

---

### 1.2 Script Configuration Options

Extracted from the embedding HTML `<script>` tag:

```typescript
interface WidgetScriptAttributes {
  /** Public widget key (Required, format: rd_live_*) */
  widgetKey: string;

  /** Base URL for ResolvDesk API (Optional, defaults to script src origin) */
  apiBase?: string;
}
```

---

## 2. Server-Side Data Models & Schemas

### 2.1 Public Widget Configuration (`PublicWidgetConfigResponse`)

Returned by `GET /api/v1/widget/config?key={key}`:

```python
class PublicWidgetConfigResponse(BaseModel):
    widget_key: str
    bot_display_name: str
    welcome_message: str
    primary_color: str
    widget_placement: str  # "bottom-right" | "bottom-left"
    allowed_origins: str   # Comma-separated domains or "*"
```

---

### 2.2 Visitor Chat Stream Request & Responses

#### Request (`POST /api/v1/widget/chat`)

```python
class ChatRequest(BaseModel):
    widget_key: str = Field(min_length=8, max_length=64)
    message: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=1000)
    conversation_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None
```

#### SSE Stream Events

| Event Name | Payload Format | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `start` | `{"conversation_id": "uuid"}` | Emitted immediately when conversation is initialized or resolved. |
| `token` | `{"token": "string"}` | Streamed incrementally as tokens are generated. |
| `citation` | `{"citations": [{"document_id": "uuid", "title": "string"}]}` | Emitted when knowledge base documents are referenced. |
| `escalate_suggestion` | `{"suggest_escalation": true}` | Emitted when confidence is low or fallback triggered. |
| `done` | `{"conversation_id": "uuid", "message_id": "uuid"}` | Emitted when generation completes. |
| `error` | `{"detail": "string"}` | Emitted if an error occurs during execution. |

---

### 2.3 Visitor Escalation Request & Response

#### Request (`POST /api/v1/widget/chat/escalate`)

```python
class ChatEscalateRequest(BaseModel):
    widget_key: str = Field(min_length=8, max_length=64, description="Public widget key")
    conversation_id: uuid.UUID = Field(description="Active conversation ID")
    visitor_email: EmailStr = Field(description="Visitor's email address for follow-up")
    reason: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=500, description="Optional inquiry summary or user note")
```

#### Response (`ChatEscalateResponse`)

```python
class ChatEscalateResponse(BaseModel):
    ticket_id: str = Field(description="Formatted human-readable ticket reference e.g. TK-AB12CD")
    conversation_id: uuid.UUID
    visitor_email: str
    status: str = Field(default="submitted")
    created_at: datetime
```

---

### 2.4 Database Entity Updates

- **`Conversation` Table** (`backend/app/models/conversation.py`):
  - `is_escalated`: Flagged to `True` upon successful escalation submission.
- **`Message` Table** (`backend/app/models/conversation.py`):
  - Appends an audit message turn:
    - `role`: `"system"`
    - `content`: `"Ticket TK-XXXXXX submitted by visitor (email: customer@example.com). Reason: ..."`
